findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: about_levered, free_analysis · Public sink: free_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: about_levered, free_analysis · Public sink: free_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
